parts:
On 12/03/2014 10:44 PM, Jonas H wrote:
> My workaround would be to square the indicator variabales x4, x5, x6,
> but that seems a bit inelegant and I am also not completely sure whether
> this is equivalent.

lavaan (unlike lm() and glm()) does not support the poly() and I()
special functions inside the model syntax.

You must create the additional terms (eg quadratic terms) yourself, and
add them to the data.frame. Then, you can include them as regular variables.

Yves.
